faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Portuguese.

items.q: Does it handle Portuguese accents correctly?
items.a: Yes, letters and marks like ã, õ, ç, and á appear correctly in both the written translation and what gets spoken aloud.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Portuguese back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Portuguese into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it work for both European and Brazilian Portuguese speakers?
items.a: It translates into standard Portuguese that's understood across Portuguese-speaking countries, good for everyday conversations and travel.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, it runs in your browser on desktop or mobile — nothing to download.

items.q: Can I hear how the Portuguese translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.
